message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest and most frequented farmers‑market in the city, drawing hundreds of thousands of visitors each season. The market is open every Saturday, Sunday, Wednesday, and Friday (except holidays) and offers a wide variety of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local products. Its central location in Union Square, combined with its reputation for quality and variety, makes it the go‑to destination for both locals and tourists looking to experience New York’s vibrant food scene.
